name: B10-0074/2025 (S&D) – Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls Russia's war against Ukraine illegal and unjustified. It rejects Russia's false historical claims and disinformation used to justify the war. It asks Russia to stop fighting and withdraw all forces from Ukraine. It supports holding Russian leaders accountable through the International Criminal Court and a new special tribunal for aggression. It urges the European Union to fight Russian disinformation, expand sanctions on Russian media, and fund education on European history.

- The Parliament states positions and requests; it does not change laws itself.
- Russia, European Union member states, and Russian media are the main targets.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union institutions and Ukraine's government.
